feeds.title: The Budget Babe
feeds.description: Featuring the latest cheap-chic fashion news, designer and celebrity looks-for-less, and honest reports on the places you all love to shop. The Budget Babe is a affordable fashion blog for style-conscious women everywhere who are looking to stretch their wardrobe dollars.

feeds.title: Ali Manno
feeds.description: Ali highlights her passion for budget-friendly fashion and serves as an outlet for her and other new moms to share their experiences.

feeds.title: Penny Pincher Fashion
feeds.description: Penny Pincher Fashion has become synonymous with style on a budget. Kimberly is known for her closet creativity and her innate ability to stretch her dollars. She is passionate about finding the best fashion and beauty for less and helping you make the most of your wardrobe without breaking the bank.

feeds.title: Budget Fashionista
feeds.description: Since 2003, Budget Fashionista has been a beacon for fashion-conscious women, offering empowering insights on looking fabulous without breaking the bank. The Budget Fashionista community invites women of all ages to discover the art of styling, smart shopping, staying on-trend, and achieving a stunning look without a hefty price tag. Join this vibrant community to unlock the secrets of affordable fashion and embrace a stylish life on a budget.

feeds.title: Stay Classic
feeds.description: Blog articles on men's fashion, menswear, formal, casual and more. Stay Classic is an affordable approach to classic men's style blog by Tim.

feeds.title: Carrie Bradshaw Lied
feeds.description: A life & style blog by Kathleen. I consider myself a budget-friendly fashionista and love sharing my discoveries with you guys in not only fashion, but also home, travel, personal content and more.

feeds.title: Something Good
feeds.description: Something Good is my way to explore new styles, develop my personal style, and learn how to budget appropriately for my wardrobe.

feeds.title: Poor Little It Girl Blog
feeds.description: Poor Little It Girl is a fashion and lifestyle blog founded by Cathy Peshek. The blog is a destination for affordable style and beauty, and Cathy shares her favorite fashion finds, beauty products, and travel adventures. The blog also features various lifestyle topics such as home decor and entertaining.

feeds.title: LivingLesh
feeds.description: LivingLesh is a fashion and luxe lifestyle blog where you will style tips, travel guides, beauty hacks, and little tidbits on how to live your best life. Iesha Vincent, aka Lesh, is a Philadelphia fashion and lifestyle blogger, podcaster, book author, wife, mom, and an African American influencer that is currently based in the Philly area suburbs.

feeds.title: Lovely In LA
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rachel a Contemporary Plus-Size Fashion style blogger featuring outfit posts, events, and fashion inspiration for curvy girls.

feeds.title: More With Less Today
feeds.description: Lori Felix is a fashion blogger who started MoreWithLessToday.com in 2009 as a way to share her tips and life hacks. Check out hot deals and steals seen on TV, flash sales, clearance links, home decor dupes, high/low fashion, and saving sources at More with Less Today.

feeds.title: Champagne & Savings Blog
feeds.description: Champagne & Savings is for the millennial babe on a budget who loves keeping up with the trends! With a splash of humor and a love for trendy finds, Katie shares mostly budget fashion with some beauty, home decor, and other budget-friendly and on-trend ideas to make your life easier. Katie is here to help you see that you don't have to break the bank to look and feel your best.

feeds.title: I do deClaire
feeds.description: A budget-friendly lifestyle and fashion blog for the busy mom.

feeds.title: Sweet Sauce Blog
feeds.description: Sweet Sauce Blog is a place to get inspired to live a sweeter life. From fashion to travel to beauty, I've got the tips, products and styles that will help you shine brighter with budget.

feeds.title: Kleidermaedchen
feeds.description: Kleidermaedchen is a fashion, beauty and lifestyle blog from Germany.

feeds.title: Affordable Fashion Co. Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts dealing with affordable fashion on an efficient and time-saving budget.

feeds.title: THE BALLER ON A BUDGET
feeds.description: THE BALLER ON A BUDGET is an affordable luxury lifestyle, fashion and beauty blog by Aileen Luib. From money management to frugal fashion, I help people indulge in the most-coveted trends and products without breaking the bank, because everyone deserves champagne taste, even on a beer budget.

feeds.title: The Frugality
feeds.description: A Freelance Fashion Stylist working and living in London. This blog is not about living off toast every night. This is an affordably stylish guide to dressing well.

feeds.title: Hello Rigby
feeds.description: Hello Rigby is a Seattle based fashion and beauty blog. Fashion doesn't have to be expensive! Look cheap on the chic with my style tips, attainable makeup looks, and easy to follow beauty tutorials for the everyday millennial woman.

feeds.title: Style Uncovered
feeds.description: Budget fashion blog helping women find luxe style for less! A budget fashion blog helping women with enviable style find great deals and style inspiration while shopping on a budget!

feeds.title: The LV Guide
feeds.description: The Best Shopping, Trends & Inspiration For Your Everyday From Lilliana Vazquez.

feeds.title: Frugal Shopaholics
feeds.description: Covers articles about affordable fashion and budget shopping for those who shop for best bargains. Frugal Shopaholics, created in April 2013 by Christen Hamilton and Derria Underwood, is a blog dedicated to those who enjoy shopping, but don't want to break the bank while doing so.

feeds.title: Looking Fly on a Dime
feeds.description: Affordable style expert helping women look their best, for less. Looking Fly on a Dime author. Thrift shopping pro. Glitter in my veins.

feeds.title: RUN STYLE RUN
feeds.description: There's something about Brandi's style we can't quite put our finger on. Maybe it's the incredible vintage finds she lands, or how her looks are the perfect balance of simple and stunning. Whatever it is, she's good.

feeds.title: Tracy's Notebook of Style
feeds.description: Tracy is another Target lover, and a lot of her images feature items from the store. Shopaholic on a Budget Sharing Affordable Finds from Fashion, Beauty and more.

feeds.title: Curlybyrdie Chirps
feeds.description: I am a 40 something mom that loves to be fashionable on a budget. Who says you can't be fabulous without breaking the bank!

feeds.title: Here & Now
feeds.description: Here&Now is a Nashville style blog that features Jessica's favorite fashions, style steals, lifestyle features and the occasional pug pictures. Jessica loves blogging about her journey to define her personal style, budget shopping, fashion finds & travel.

feeds.title: Restyle.Restore.Rejoice
feeds.description: Hey! I'm Francesca, I'm a style blogger living in the beautiful Bay Area. I'm infatuated with fashion.A budget fashion and lifestyle blog written by Francesca Penko.

feeds.title: Moxie
feeds.description: Christine is from California, and has serious casual, California-girl style. Her outfits feature lots of denim and comfort, with some fun pieces like this dress thrown in.

feeds.title: SG Style Me
feeds.description: A Fashion Blog by Raving Fashionista for Daily Style Inspiration on a Budget. Sarah started as a way to share her passion for personal style, while hopefully providing a little everyday outfit inspiration along the way.

feeds.title: The Werk! Place - Personal Style Blog
feeds.description: The Werk! Place is a contemporary lifestyle brand dedicated to enhancing and highlighting the lifestyle of women through a fashion lens. The Werk! Place explores all aspects of today's woman. Whether it's personal style, travel, success, failure and transition, the motto is to 'Werk It!'.

feeds.title: Chic on the Cheap
feeds.description: Connecticut based personal style blog by Lydia Abate, based on a budget; because you should never sacrifice style for savings.

feeds.title: J's Everyday Fashion
feeds.description: Covers outfit ideas, budget fashion, shopping on a budget, personal style inspiration, and tips on what to wear. J is on a mission to help, inspire and encourage women on a budget everywhere! She is proof that style is not just something you are born with, but that it can be learned.

feeds.title: The Budget Blog
feeds.description: Hi! Nice that you take a look at my blog. I am Lotte, am 17 years old and have a great passion for makeup, beauty and fashion. My goal is also to show that look good, need not be expensive.

feeds.title: Frugal Fashion Shopper
feeds.description: Penny Kocher writes about finding wonderful clothes for the older woman in charity shops and issues around women and aging. She is 75 years old and has built up a great wardrobe on very little money.
